verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client covering cloning, committing, SSH keys, previews and automation. It is not a Python runtime or terminal environment, so installing pip packages on the device is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships a Python interpreter or pip; the only scripting mentioned is a JavaScript console for repository scripts, which does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install additional pure-Python packages using pip directly on my device
